verdict.rationale: Chroma has no built-in natural-language command interface, but its official MCP server lets Claude interact with Chroma's search capabilities, and its getting-started docs give a prompt for Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex to set up Chroma. So natural-language operation works only through an external AI agent. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command interface, documentation of which operations (collection management, writes, admin) can be driven conversationally via MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
